run_hydra_app: run the my_app Hydra application that instantiates User and Admin objects from config
instantiate_user_from_config: use hydra.utils.instantiate to create a User object from the cfg.user config node
instantiate_admin_from_config: use hydra.utils.instantiate to create an Admin object from the cfg.admin config node
register_config_schema: store a config schema mapping UserConf and AdminConf dataclasses in the Hydra ConfigStore
review_hydra_main_decorator: review the hydra.main decorator that configures the app with config_path and config_name
